svg.title: Microstrip, stripline, CPW and GCPW cross-sections
svg.desc: Four printed-circuit transmission lines seen end-on, with computed field lines. Microstrip: trace over a ground plane with air above. Stripline: trace buried between two ground planes, all fields in the dielectric. CPW: trace with ground strips beside it on the same layer and no plane below. GCPW: the same plus a ground plane below, tied to the top grounds with a fence of vias.
svg.text: The four PCB line types, seen end-on (FR-4, εr = 4.4; field lines from a 2-D solve)
trace on top, ground plane below
ground beside the trace, none below
ground beside and below, tied by vias
GCPW is cut through the via fence; between vias the top grounds are tied to the plane only through the vias. Not to scale with each other.
